We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (id 1914385) to the given molecule (initial_molecule SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O). The template search task gave mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to apply the template to the molecule to get precursors.

We have tool apply_template which takes molecule_smiles and template_id, returns possible outcomes (precursors). Let's call it.
